verdict: Clean: the Wood's handmade floor. Cleared with four stars and no fall, no console error; every spot reachable in both states of the walking paths; the wisps, the roots, the rival (Nyx), the trial, the Elder Root (own model) and the gate (Fenna) all played; the people and their lines match the Codex (the Moss-Abbess's horn, the Path-Lighter's spore lamps).

found.title: Two packs the bot never woke
found.text: The bramble's thorn sprites and the giants' glade sleep through the bot's route: nothing it is asked to do takes it near them (they spawn and fight as anyone walks in: pictures below).

found.title: The props the probe flagged
found.text: The Wood's trees are its cover, so the probe's thousands of “in cover” are the trees themselves; the “float” are white spore motes drifting in the air (meant), and pines on the hills past the edge; a few leaves lie a hair under the ground.
